resource: bytes of one ACTOR_COOLDOWNS entry, its tag and length included
allocation_impact: An entry is at most 16 bytes: the kind, an id up to 2^28 - 1 (a spell index; a group ordinal is at most 16) and expires_at_ms below 2^42. server_now_ms, rtt_ms and rtt_estimated are per message (at most 15 bytes), outside the entry bound; a payload is at most 65,552 bytes. The decoder refuses a longer entry LimitExceeded.
boundary_tests: max=16: crates/protocol-oteryn/src/presentation_tests.rs cooldowns_round_trip_within_their_bounds (the largest entry is 16 bytes)
max+1=17: crates/protocol-oteryn/src/presentation_tests.rs malformed_cooldowns_fail_closed (a 17-byte entry is refused LimitExceeded)
notes: SPELL-PRESENT-0 §10 and §13. Mirrors max_payload_bytes of the domain 20 types (16 + 4,096 x 16). Registered by PRESENT-WIRE-1 (MAGIC-CAST-1, #1622).
